  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

Co-Chair Jamies Shufford, called the meeting to order at 3:06 p.m Member Claude Diles walks in at
3:16 p.m. For the record, members McCullom and Bambrick are no longer part of the CoC Board and
will be removed from the header.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Tan, Topolewski, Washington, Diles III, Brezenoff, McFadzen, Richert,
Martins, Amick, Chotiswatdi, Bambrick, Boyce, McCullom, Shuford, Wee, Lewis, Lock

Also present: Stephanie Sosa, Community Program Specialist, Jennifer Santana, Secretary,
Jeffrey Proctor, Attendee.

Roll call taken by Jennifer Santana.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-54063  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Continuum of Care (CoC) Board
  Meeting of December 10, 2024.

  A motion was made by Member Amick, seconded by Member Richert, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  11 Tan, Topolewski, Diles III, Brezenoff, McFadzen, Richert, Martins,
  Amick, Chotiswatdi, Shuford, Wee
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 5 Washington, Bambrick, Boyce, Lewis, Lock

2.  25-54064  Recommendation to approve the CoC Board applications candidates.

  Page 1 of 5
   LONG BEACH CONTINUUM OF CARE MINUTES

  4811 AIRPORT PLAZA DR.

  A motion was made by Member Brezenoff, seconded by Member Topolewski,
  to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  11 Tan, Topolewski, Diles III, Brezenoff, McFadzen, Richert, Martins,
  Amick, Chotiswatdi, Shuford, Wee
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 5 Washington, Bambrick, Boyce, Lewis, Lock

  • Three applicants applied for the CoC Board. Two of them, Steven
  Rockenbach and Hershey’s Ann Ramil, were present and gave a brief
  overview of their current roles and interest in joining the board. Staff provided
  a brief summary of the third applicant John Andrews.
  • The board voted to move forward with applicants Steven and Hershey’s Ann.

3.  25-54067  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the CoC’s Subcommittee
  titles Advisory Board for Lived Experience.

  A motion was made by Member McFadzen, seconded by Member Brezenoff,
  to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  11 Tan, Topolewski, Diles III, Brezenoff, McFadzen, Richert, Martins,
  Amick, Chotiswatdi, Shuford, Wee
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 5 Washington, Bambrick, Boyce, Lewis, Lock

  • Homeless Services Projects Officer Jeffrey Proctor provided updates on the
  CoC’s subcommittees and Advisory Board for Lived Experience.
  • Updates included an overview of the bylaws and restructuring of
  subcommittee names and overview of roles. Board members who are
  interested in joining the subcommittee have informed staff.

4.  25-54068  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the CoC Governance Charter
  and Bylaws.

  A motion was made by Member Brezenoff, seconded by Member Martins, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  11 Tan, Topolewski, Diles III, Brezenoff, McFadzen, Richert, Martins,

  Amick, Chotiswatdi, Shuford, Wee
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 5  Washington, Bambrick, Boyce, Lewis, Lock

  • Homeless Services Projects Officer, Jeffrey Proctor, provided updates on
  changes to the charter’s general membership to help increase engagement.
  • Staff and board members discussed the possibility of having these meetings
  at the Long Beach Coalition to help increase public engagement. Board
  members have concerns regarding the CoC general meetings sharing the
  same space as the LB coalition.

5.  25-54085  Recommendation to review and discuss the meeting schedule for the Long Beach
  CoC Board.

  A motion was made by Member Amick, seconded by Member Topolewski, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  11 Tan, Topolewski, Diles III, Brezenoff, McFadzen, Richert, Martins,
  Amick, Chotiswatdi, Shuford, Wee
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 5 Washington, Bambrick, Boyce, Lewis, Lock

  • Staff discussed concerns regarding future meeting spaces and the possibility
  of moving the board meeting times to a later hour. The board agreed to keep
  the meeting times as they are and primarily host the meetings at the Billie
  Jean King Library.

6.  25-54065  Recommendation to receive and file the Homeless Services Bureau Staff and
  Operations Update presentation by Paul Duncan from the Health Department.

  A motion was made by Member Martins, seconded by Member McFadzen, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  11 Tan, Topolewski, Diles III, Brezenoff, McFadzen, Richert, Martins,
  Amick, Chotiswatdi, Shuford, Wee
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 5 Washington, Bambrick, Boyce, Lewis, Lock

  Page 3 of 5
   LONG BEACH CONTINUUM OF CARE MINUTES
  TUESDAY, JANUARY 14, 2025
  4811 AIRPORT PLAZA DR.
  PACIFIC GATEWAY, 3:00 PM

  • Homeless Services Staff Steven Perle provided updated components of
  the PIT Count, 370 staff and volunteers have signed up for the day of the
  count.
  • Homeless Services Staff Charisse Mercado provided the Staff update
  report.
  • Operational updates included information regarding the Prop 1 projects at
  the MSC and 702 Anaheim shelter.
  • The inclement weather shelter has activated since Tuesday 1/7 in response
  to the LA fires. This provides 60 additional beds per evening at the MSC.
  • HUD released the 2024 Annual Homelessness Assessment Report showing
  an 18% increase in homelessness nationwide.

7.  25-54066  Recommendation to receive and file the HSAC Representative Report.

  A motion was made by , seconded by , to approve recommendation. The
  motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  11 Tan, Topolewski, Diles III, Brezenoff, McFadzen, Richert, Martins,
  Amick, Chotiswatdi, Shuford, Wee
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 5 Washington, Bambrick, Boyce, Lewis, Lock

  • Member Kimberly Lewis was absent, staff provided an update regarding the
  HSAC meeting on January 8, 2025.Major updates included the committee's
  decision to move forward with approving the Standard Operating Procedure
  for the Mayor’s Fund application process, as well as the consideration of
  moving the meeting time to later in the evening to encourage greater public
  participation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

  • No public comment.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

  • No announcements.
